comments.text: Apparently the universe operates on MCU physics. You can make anything sound fantastical if you just put "quantum" in front of everything. There are no other universes, all the consequences of a choice is reality, the "what might have happened" exists in your mind as a thought experiment. It isnt real and we need to stop with the "maybe t's a simulation" garbage.
